new_figure_review.meaning: Three neuronal activity coordinates restricted by r3=(r1+r2)/2 require two independent coordinates. The same twelve synthetic states appear in both panels. This is a teaching construction, not recorded brain data.
checks: rank-two basis and point correspondence checked by generator
activity coordinates distinguish states from wiring
labels, axis arrows, points and grid legible without collisions
grayscale, explicit synthetic-data caption and alt text
curvature, noise and task dependence acknowledged; no claim that unvisited states are impossible
